title: Text Volume Chapter 552 Heroes
content:
Text Volume Chapter 552 Heroes

"I am safe, and so is the world. How is the head of Guizhou safe?"

Not only in Jimo City, Jiaodong, but also in the four counties of Qidi, this oral edict of Qin Shihuang spread throughout every county and county!

In Di County, Linzi County, at the Tiandan Mansion by the Jishui River, dozens or hundreds of young and strong men in brown clothes, as well as young men with shaggy hair and weak crowns, have quietly gathered. Without exception, they all have swords at their waists. Many years ago, The order to withdraw troops has had little effect in Qi. There are only forty officials in Linzi. Who will withdraw the troops for you?

This group of former knight-errants had been favored by the Tian Dan brothers and had been controlled by Qin Law for several years. They had long complained. Now that Tian Dan was summoned and wanted to plan something big, the knights came happily to discuss the big plan.

But this passionate anti-Qin mobilization meeting was interrupted by an oral edict. Although Tian Dan repeatedly emphasized loudly that this was false, the light knights who were timid in fighting and brave enough to hold a spear looked at each other, and many of them showed hesitation...

The emperor's majesty of patrolling the land is still there. Is it really okay to jump out and rebel at this time?

…

"Since the tyrant is still here, I am afraid that we need to take a long-term approach to counter Qin and restore Qi."

In Qiancheng County, not far from Di County, the hiding place of Prince Tianjia, the younger brother of King Jian of Qi, was once the sacrifice of the ancestral temple, but now it is the sacrifice of Deng Mu.

Tianjia, who looked just like a farmer, had already been encouraged by Tian Rong and persuaded him to relent and agreed to participate in the rehabilitation plan.

But after hearing Qin Shihuang's words, Tian Jia began to regret and shook his head repeatedly. Tian Rong, who came to invite him, became furious and cursed:

"It's not enough to fight with Shuzi!"

…

To the south of Linzi, across Mount Tai, hundreds of miles away in Bianyi, Xue County, the oral instructions arrived together with the Qin officials and soldiers who captured the assassins. Zhang Liang stood outside the county temple. After listening to these words, he let out a long sigh.

"What a pity."

He destroyed his family to save people from trouble, avenged South Korea, and assassinated Qin Shihuang. In the end, he failed to succeed, but the brave man died in vain. The eleven years of planning were all in vain.

Then Zhang Liang smiled helplessly and walked calmly. Shi Shiran walked into the crowd and acted openly under the eyes of Qin officials, as if the matter had nothing to do with him, and walked directly to the most dangerous Donghai County. !

A tooth for a tooth, an eye for an eye, the fifth generation of the Zhang family is facing each other, Zhang Zifang's desire to destroy Qin and restore the country is not dead yet!

…

The same is true for Qilu, and the same is true for Chu.

In Tan County, East China Sea, on another dark night, Zhongli Mei and Tian Zhong met again in Tanzi Temple.

Unlike the impassioned speech last time, this time the two of them were silent for a long time. They saw with their own eyes today that Qin Shihuang's chariot started up again. The majestic emperor was sitting in the chariot. It seemed that he was indeed fine. The foundation of the Qin Dynasty was still as unshakable as it had been in the past.

"Hero Qilu, we had a good discussion before and wanted to take advantage of the opportunity to take action, but now, we have all backed down." Tian Zhong sighed.

Zhongli Mei nodded: "The Xiang family has also decided not to get involved in this matter for the time being. After all, Xiang Liang, the backbone of the Xiang family, is currently detained in Guanzhong and is not allowed to return home. Xiang (Uncle Xiang) may not be able to get anything done... …”

"How about waiting a little longer?"

The voice gradually became deeper, and in the second half of the night, shouts came from outside the door. However, when the Qin officials who received the report and came to arrest the prisoner kicked open the broken door of Tanzi Temple, they found nothing. Only behind the statue of Tanzi, a Chu-style dagger was found, with the word "Zhongli" engraved on it...

…

In the southern part of Donghai County, across the Huai River, there is Huaiyin County with crisscrossed water networks. A young man in ragged clothes and a thin face is sitting at the Nanchang Pavilion, wolfing down the little food the pavilion soldiers gave him.

While eating, he raised his head and listened to the director of the pavilion solemnly reading Qin Shihuang's oral edict. He immediately stopped chewing and thought deeply.

The young man's parents died early and he is a commoner. He has just turned 17 this year. His surname is Han, and his name is "Xin". It is said that a passing father-in-law gave him the name. The old man called himself a military strategist. After eating the fish he caught, he taught Han Xin the art of war for a few days, which was a useless skill for the head of Guizhou.

Han Xin once had a whim and wanted to be an official, but the local people thought that he was poor and incompetent, so he could not be selected as an official. He also thought highly of himself and was unwilling to become a lowly merchant. So he just idled around like this, living in a shabby temple. Wrapped in a straw mat, he could sleep all day. When he was hungry, he would eat and drink everywhere.

In the past few days, Han Xin followed the good-tempered and kind-hearted head of the Nanchang Pavilion, hanging around the Nanchang Pavilion every meal time, eating leftovers. Others said he was shameless, but he just smiled helplessly.

When the news of Qin Shihuang's assassination came, Han Xin was the most excited person. He even sold his last complete piece of clothing and bought a broken sword, as if preparing for something big.

But today, after learning that the emperor was well, the look in Han Xin's eyes dimmed a bit.

"What I learned is the art of slaying dragons. It won't be of use unless we encounter troubled times!"

…

To the west of the East China Sea, in the west gate of Huaiyang City in Chen County, the hero Zhang Er, who had been dormant under the pseudonym of Zhang Er for seven or eight years, was already a "native" who was extremely skilled in fighting with the Qin officials.

He was still doing his job at the inner gate. When the county officials came to give orders, he nodded and bowed, and even kicked his "son". In fact, it was his good brother Chen Yu who kicked him and asked him to read Qin Shihuang loudly to the head of the inner prison at the inner gate. The oral instructions were just like the two men reciting their wanted orders loudly before.

After reading, Zhang Er and Chen Yu made eye contact, and the meaning was very obvious.

"Sure enough, we still have to wait..."

…

In Yangxia County, north of Huaiyang, the late spring sun was scorching. Farmers who had just finished working passed by the rural pavilion and listened to the emperor's oral instructions read by the postman. The farmers' expressions were indifferent, as if the matter had nothing to do with them. Only Chen Sheng, who was quite old, was leaning on his arm. Farm tools, thoughtfully.

"If the emperor is safe, then the world will be safe...how can we, the head of Guizhou, dare to be uneasy?"

The declaration of "Be rich and honorable, never forget each other" many years ago has not become a reality. Chen Sheng has not become a swan. He is still an inconspicuous sparrow, flapping his wings in the uncertain trend of the times, struggling as a peasant and a laborer. On the line of food and clothing.

At this time, the postman finished reading the emperor's oral instructions and was about to rush to the next pavilion. When he saw Chen Sheng pulling him to ask questions, he chatted for a few more words. Unexpectedly, they had a very happy conversation.

Seeing that it was getting late and he had to hit the road, this dark and skinny postman bowed to Chen Shengzuo and said goodbye, smiling: "I am from Yangxia, Wu Guang..."

…

Not only them, Liu Ji, the general who was ordered to guard Liugong Island in Jiaodong, sharpened his sword. After hearing the news, he frowned and then smiled, not knowing whether he was happy or worried.

But in Wu County, Kuaiji County, a sturdy young man who was placed here anonymously by his family learned about this, but he threw down the sword in his hand and made a bold statement: "It would be better if you don't die. Kill the First Emperor and destroy the Qin Dynasty." , Xiang Ji must do it himself!"

In short, in the land of Qi and Chu, some of the heroes and rebels of the late Qin Dynasty in history were already ready to take action, and some had already smelled different rumors. However, after Qin Shihuang's oral instructions came, they all agreed invariably. Shrinking his head, he gave up his previous thoughts.

In countless cities and towns, rumors of the emperor's death, along with the restless atmosphere, almost made noise, but at this moment they all stopped. The lively market went from rumors to silence!

That figure stood in the sky for so long that the leaders of Guizhou could see him when they raised their heads.

He is like the sun in the sky, extremely fierce, blazing down on thirty million creatures in the world, but as long as it does not set for a moment, nocturnal animals will not dare to take the lead easily.

"The days are mourning, and you and I will all perish."

Gao Jianli once shouted like this when he raised his sword to attack Qin Shihuang, but not many people can really make this determination.

Tian Dan, Tian Rong, Zhang Er, Chen Yu, Zhong Lizhen, Chen Sheng, Han Xin, all of them had those words echoing in their hearts at this moment:

"Unless Qin Shi Huang dies, who in this huge world would dare to rebel?"

…

"I dare!"

"I, Tian Heng, dare to raise the flag of righteousness!"

In late March, on Shaohai Island, there were dotted islands. A group of boats were moored in the bay. Tian Heng stood on the boat, holding a long oar, and knocked into the water a pirate leader who wanted to retreat after hearing Qin Shihuang's oral instructions. Then his eyes widened and he yelled angrily:

"The Qin official Heifu has already used the power of the tiger to force himself into the lintels of the fields. He wants to destroy him and then quickly, how can he still bear it? Now that the tiger is gone and the fox is alone, there is no talk of retreating after a big event has been carried out!"

He pointed towards the south and said to the Qi pirates who were either on the boat or on the shore: "Second and Third Sons, the Qidi coast is just dozens of miles away. If you continue to be a tortoise grandson, you should follow me to the shore through the waves, fight into Linzi, avenge your shame, and regain your homeland today!"
